title: DRCheckpointState
description: Standardized schema for all saved PyTorch checkpoint files (_best.pth and _last.pth)

scaler_state_dict.description: GradScaler state dictionary if FP16 AMP was used

scheduler_state_dict.description: Learning rate scheduler state dictionary if external scheduler was provided

val_qwk.description: Validation Quadratic Weighted Kappa for the epoch

best_val_qwk.description: Best Validation Quadratic Weighted Kappa recorded so far

best_val_loss.description: Lowest Validation Loss recorded so far

val_metrics.description: Comprehensive clinical validation metrics evaluated at checkpoint time

epochs_no_improve_es.description: Early stopping counter tracking epochs without val_qwk improvement

epochs_no_improve_lr.description: Plateau decay counter tracking epochs without val_loss improvement

is_completed.description: Set to true when the training fold / round has finished all scheduled epochs

metrics.description: Final consolidated test metrics recorded upon completion
